headline: India pledges 1.6 billion dollars in flood relief and economic aid to Nepal
label: NEWS
caption:
India has announced a massive aid package to help its neighbour recover from deadly natural disasters. 🇮🇳

According to Reuters and Al Jazeera, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi said India will give Nepal an economic package worth 240 billion Nepalese rupees, which is about 1.62 billion dollars. The announcement came on Monday after talks in New Delhi with Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah.

Shah is visiting the Indian capital for a two day trip, marking his first bilateral visit abroad since coming to power in March. The funds arrive in the aftermath of devastating Himalayan floods in August that k!lled more than 1,300 people and left over 5,000 missing and presumed de@d.

According to a joint statement, the package includes a 377 million dollar grant for post disaster reconstruction and new infrastructure projects, alongside a 1.24 billion dollar line of credit for energy projects. The two leaders also discussed greater cooperation in education, satellite communications and sustainable urban development, while jointly opening a new train link.
